meta.name: Selemene Engine — AI Agent Bridge Tasks
meta.description: Universal AI agent compatibility layer: OpenAPI export, framework-specific tool definitions, universal execution server, and scheduled task support. Enables Claude, OpenAI, Grok, LangChain, and CrewAI to invoke Selemene engines.
filtered_out: OpenAPI 3.1 spec generation (utoipa v4 + swagger-ui already in noesis-api/src/lib.rs)
16 documented endpoints (all health, engines, workflows, auth, users already annotated)
utoipa + axum integration (ApiDoc struct with #[derive(OpenApi)] already exists)
noesis-core ToSchema derives (already behind openapi feature flag)

tasks.title: Export static openapi.json from running server
tasks.description: curl to export from /api/openapi.json, commit as reference artifact, CI step to regenerate

tasks.title: Add OpenAPI annotations to ts-engines via Elysia swagger
tasks.description: @elysiajs/swagger plugin, serve at /docs on port 3001, document GET /health, GET /engines, GET /engines/:id/info, POST /engines/:id/calculate

tasks.title: Merge Rust + TS OpenAPI specs into unified spec
tasks.description: scripts/merge-openapi.py fetches both specs and merges, output: openapi-unified.json

tasks.title: Generate Anthropic Claude tool definitions from unified OpenAPI
tasks.description: scripts/generate-claude-tools.py, output: bridges/claude/tools.json, each endpoint → tool with name, description, input_schema

tasks.title: Generate LangChain/CrewAI Python tool classes
tasks.description: scripts/generate-langchain-tools.py, output: bridges/langchain/selemene_tools.py, StructuredTool subclasses using httpx

tasks.title: Create Claude Code SKILL.md for Selemene
Build universal tool execution server
tasks.description: bridges/universal-tool-server/main.py (FastAPI ~100 lines), POST /tools/execute with {name, arguments}, maps tool names → Selemene API, handles auth, Dockerfile

tasks.title: Add health + discovery endpoints to bridge
tasks.description: GET /tools returns available tools from OpenAPI spec, GET /health checks engines

tasks.title: Integration test suite for bridge
tasks.description: pytest with httpx, tests tool mapping, error handling, auth failure

tasks.title: Add recurring task support
tasks.description: bridges/cron/ with daily_witness.sh (Brahma Muhurta), hourly_panchanga.sh, Docker Compose with ofelia

tasks.title: End-to-end verification
tasks.description: Start all services, verify Claude tools work with Anthropic API, OpenAI functions parse, LangChain tools execute, SKILL.md works
